messages:
leah: Heads-up Hawthorne Health private deploy: staging uncovered two blockers for tomorrow's cutover (09:00 PDT): cross-account KMS rejects and audit log ingestion failing due to IAM role missing s3:PutObject. This landed as a renewal-risk on today's call.

omar: Quick findings: their KMS key policy denies our runtime role during rotation (kms:GenerateDataKey blocked). Also their delegated role doesn't include sts:AssumeRole for our runtime. I'll paste minimal policy snippets in the portal.

kevin: I'll own the infra side. Plan: 1) request KMS ARN + customer account id, 2) coordinate a staged rotation rehearsal in staging, 3) add a temporary bucket policy for audit ingest test. Need ETA from customer on when they can apply policy.

leah: Security note from the call: they asked for 120d audit retention as baseline for compliance; product supports 90d default. Flagging AMs for a retention uplift conversation.

security-bot: Compliance checklist link: https://runbooks.redwood.com/security/priv-deploy-evidence items include KMS ARN, role ARN, S3 upload proof, audit retention policy screenshots.

omar: Minimal trust statement we'll ask them to paste into their key policy (replace ACCOUNT_ID and ROLE_ARN):
"Allow account ACCOUNT_ID role ROLE_ARN to decrypt and generate data key for reencrypting during migration."

kevin: Created support ticket CS-90442 and attached failed kms logs. If staged rotation fails in staging we open a rollback window and delay cutover. Ticket updated with owner matrix.

leah: Owners & ETAs:
- omar: send policy snippets + example alias swap doc to customer by 16:30 PT
- kevin: orchestrate staged rotation & audit ingest test by 23:00 PT
- leah: notify AMs about retention request and potential commercial impact by EOD

leah: Renewal-risk: MEDIUM now. If policies applied and staged tests pass before cutover, we expect risk -> LOW. Please update thread when done. :thumbsup:
